_readme: ETC Eos starter preset for the 16-button + 3-knob macropad.
Import via the IMPORT button in the sidebar, then UPLOAD to the pad.
The 4x4 buttons are numbered row-major: row 1 = button1..4,
row 2 = button5..8, row 3 = button9..12, row 4 = button13..16.
So the LAST COLUMN is button4, button8, button12, button16 and is
assigned (per request): Recall From / Copy To / Q Only / Thru.
Each dial also has a PRESS, exposed as knob1_press / knob2_press /
knob3_press - these act as 3 extra buttons (the 'top row' overflow).
knob CW/CCW are left for you to specify.
Only well-established shortcuts are pre-filled (Live=F1, Blind=F2).
'_suggested_layout' lists the intended Eos function per control with
the PC shortcut left blank (''). Fill the blanks, move the entry into
{"key": "<name from KEY_MAP>", "ctrl": true, "shift": true, "alt": true, "win": true}
Note: Eos hardkey emulation from a keyboard generally requires Scroll Lock ON.
name: ETC EOS
